vision.name: Frieza's Death Beam
vision.text:
(Limit 1 per deck. Once per turn, if this card is destroyed or banished from your Life Deck, you may place it into your hand.)
[Attack] 2: Energy attack.
You may destroy a Setup, Drill, or Ally you control to search your Life Deck for a card of the same type and play it. [Warning]: Raise your anger 2.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
(Banish after use.)
